{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for converted customers
converted_data = data[data['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
valid_converted_data = converted_data[converted_data['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = valid_converted_data['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute the sample size for transparency
sample_size = len(valid_converted_data)

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age_converted}")
print(f"Sample size (converted customers with valid age): {sample_size}")"}
